tools.sectionHeading: Six tools. One job: stop you from overpaying.
tools.sectionSubheading: Each tool is built around a specific failure point in the healthcare billing system.
tools.policyAnalysisDesc: Most people have never actually read their insurance policy. MedFin extracts every coverage parameter, deductible, exclusion, and limit from your PDF and presents it as a readable summary. Upload once, reference all year.
tools.askAIDesc: Coverage questions usually require a 40-minute hold with your insurer. MedFin answers them instantly, grounded in your actual policy document, not generic insurance knowledge.
tools.billValidationDesc: Medical billing departments make errors at a rate that would be embarrassing in any other industry. MedFin checks every line item on your bill against your policy and flags anything that does not add up.
tools.policyOptimizationDesc: Your current plan may be optimized for someone who is not you. MedFin compares your actual healthcare usage against your plan parameters and surfaces specific, actionable changes.
tools.preVisitDesc: Knowing what your visit will cost before you walk in is not a luxury. MedFin generates a visit-specific checklist: what to verify, what to bring, what questions to ask, and what your expected out-of-pocket cost will be.
tools.appealLettersDesc: Claim denials are overturned 40 to 60 percent of the time when appealed. MedFin generates a formal appeal letter with the correct ERISA citations and denial-specific legal language, ready to print and mail.

howItWorks.heading: From upload to insight in under a minute.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop your insurance PDF into MedFin. The document is processed in memory and discarded immediately. Nothing is written to disk.
howItWorks.step2Desc: MedFin maps every coverage parameter, network rule, deductible tier, and exclusion in your plan. The process takes under 30 seconds.
howItWorks.step3Title: Use any of the six tools
howItWorks.step3Desc: All tools share the same policy context. Ask a question, validate a bill, generate an appeal letter. Everything is grounded in your specific document.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Copy answers, download your appeal letter as a PDF, or screenshot your bill validation results. Your session is yours to manage.

results.heading: What people actually find.
results.result1Desc: A patient uploaded an EOB from an outpatient visit. MedFin flagged a duplicate charge for an anesthesia unit that appeared twice under different billing codes. The hospital reversed it within a week.
results.result2Desc: A freelancer's current plan had a $6,000 deductible they were never hitting. MedFin identified a comparable plan with a $2,500 deductible at $94 less per month.
results.result3Desc: An MRI claim was denied as not medically necessary. MedFin generated an appeal citing ERISA Section 503 and the plan's own definition of medical necessity. The claim was approved on first appeal.

disclaimer.line1: MedFin AI is not a licensed insurance advisor, attorney, or healthcare provider.
disclaimer.line2: Nothing on this platform constitutes legal, medical, or financial advice.
disclaimer.line3: MedFin does not store, log, or transmit your documents or policy data. All processing happens in memory and is discarded when your session ends.
